disposition_reason: Paris supermarket survey (Nov-Dec 2015) of 68 milk, dairy and cereal products for total Cr and Cr(VI). The only chocolate-related items are composite foods: breakfast cereals containing chocolate (four samples, total Cr 360-483 µg/kg fw) and a dry chocolate biscuit (236 µg/kg fw); no cocoa or chocolate material itself was analysed.
disposition_locator: Sampling plan, p.2; Results 'Total chromium and Cr(VI) content', p.4; Table 3 p.4

study.design: market survey with dietary exposure assessment
study.material_scope: milk, dairy and cereal products (no cocoa/chocolate material)
study.growing_origin_vs_market: purchased in a local supermarket in Paris, France
study.method: Total Cr by ICP-MS after microwave HNO3 digestion; Cr(VI) by alkaline NH4OH extraction and HPLC-ICP-MS
study.lod_loq: Total Cr LOD 5, LOQ 10 µg/kg; Cr(VI) milk & dairy LOD 0.3, LOQ 0.6 µg/kg (Table 2)

notes: Authors cite EFSA (2014) that cocoa-containing products have high Cr; context only. Cr(VI) not detected in any sample including the chocolate-containing cereals.
